# Citad3L

> Citad3L is a private, less-filtered AI chat app at https://citad3l.io, founded by Cruz Garza. Adult text chat between adults is allowed. The only hard lines are no sexual content involving minors and nothing about bombs or explosives.

This file is a plain summary for AI tools and search engines. Everything here is also stated on the public pages linked below.

## Models

- Citad3L V1: the default, best all-round chat model. Supports web search and extended thinking for signed-in users, and can look at uploaded images.
- Citad3L Fast: a cheaper, quicker chat model for short tasks. Can look at uploaded images.
- Citad3L Private: chat in a verified secure enclave (text only, signed-in). The browser sends the message to Citad3L's server over HTTPS. The server reads it, runs a safety check, then encrypts it to the enclave. This is not end-to-end encryption from the device.
- Swarm mode: V1 plans, up to three Fast workers answer parts in parallel, V1 writes the reply (signed-in).

## Plans

- Free: try Citad3L with no card. Guests get five successful replies without an account; failed or stopped replies never count. A free account gets 3 messages every day on Fast and Private, resetting at midnight Central.
- Pro: $20 per month (25 replies every 5 hours, up to 150 a week).
- Max: $50 per month, 2.5x the Pro allowance, plus per-model settings.
- Paid plans are open. Subscribe on the pricing page. They renew monthly until you cancel. First-time buyers, through January 31, 2027: Pro is $10 the first month, then $20/month. Max is $25 the first month, then $50/month. Checkout applies that price.

## Sign-in

- Enter your email and Citad3L sends a 6-digit code. There are no passwords.
- Signed-in users can export or delete their data from their account.
